entries.en: The saved setup could not be read. Clear it and request a new setup code.
entries.rw: Igenamiterere ryabitswe ntiryasomwe. Risibe, usabe kode nshya y’igenamiterere.

entries.en: Sign-out could not be saved. Contact an administrator.
Check the setup code provided by your administrator.
Choose a file, review the extracted rows and register only verified members.
entries.rw: Hitamo dosiye, suzuma imirongo yavuyemo maze wandikishe abasuzumwe gusa.

entries.en: The previous action needs authenticated reconciliation. Do not repeat it; contact your administrator if the session changed.
entries.rw: Igikorwa cyabanje gikeneye kugenzurwa n’ufite uburenganzira. Ntukigisubiremo; vugana n’umuyobozi niba uburenganzira bwo kwinjira bwahindutse.

entries.en: Eligible earlier MoMo payments may be matched and credited automatically after you add this member.
entries.rw: Nyuma yo kongeramo uyu munyamuryango, ubwishyu bwa MoMo bwabanje bujuje ibisabwa bushobora guhuzwa na we maze imisanzu ye ikandikwa mu buryo bwikora.

entries.en: The export contains invalid table data.

entries.en: Finish or cancel the current sign-in before changing phone setup.
entries.rw: Banza urangize cyangwa uhagarike kwinjira mbere yo guhindura igenamiterere rya telefoni.

entries.en: Reduce screen transitions and loading motion. Android controls keyboard and dialog animations.
entries.rw: Gabanya uko ecran ihinduka n’amashusho yerekana ko amakuru akizanwa. Android igenzura uko clavier n’amadirishya bifunguka.

entries.en: Original SMS access is unconfirmed. Close and check before trying again.
entries.rw: Kureba SMS y’umwimerere ntikiremezwa. Funga iri dirishya, ubanze ugenzure mbere yo kongera kugerageza.

entries.en: No eligible members. Change the search or ask an administrator.
entries.rw: Nta banyamuryango bujuje ibisabwa babonetse. Hindura ibyo ushakisha cyangwa ubaze umuyobozi.

entries.en: Local recovery storage is unavailable. Do not repeat the action or clear app data; contact the administrator.
entries.rw: Ububiko bwo kuri iyi telefoni bukenewe mu kugarura amakuru ntibuboneka. Ntusubiremo igikorwa cyangwa ngo usibe amakuru ya porogaramu; vugana n’umuyobozi.

entries.en: Recovery evidence is inconsistent. The action remains unresolved; contact the administrator.
entries.rw: Amakuru yo kugenzura igikorwa ntahuye. Igisubizo cyacyo ntikiramenyekana; vugana n’umuyobozi.

entries.en: The original action could not be verified for this account and phone. Do not repeat it or clear app data; contact the administrator.
entries.rw: Igikorwa cya mbere nticyashoboye kugenzurwa kuri iyi konti n’iyi telefoni. Ntukigisubiremo cyangwa ngo usibe amakuru ya porogaramu; vugana n’umuyobozi.

entries.en: The previous action needs an authenticated outcome check. Sign in with the same operator on this phone and check it. Do not repeat the action.
entries.rw: Igisubizo cy’igikorwa cyabanje kigomba kugenzurwa nyuma yo kwinjira. Injira ukoresheje konti y’umukozi wakigize kuri iyi telefoni maze ukigenzure. Ntusubiremo igikorwa.

entries.en: Action not accepted. Review the details.
Sign in again to check the original action. Do not submit it again.
entries.rw: Kugenzura igisubizo byahagaritswe. Igikorwa cya mbere kiracyategereje igisubizo; ubaze umuyobozi.

entries.en: An outcome check is already running. Do not repeat the financial action.
entries.rw: Kugenzura igisubizo biracyakorwa. Tegereza; ntusubiremo igikorwa cya mbere.

entries.en: Outcome checks have stopped. Do not repeat the action or clear app data; contact the administrator.
entries.rw: Kugenzura ibisubizo byahagaritswe. Ntusubiremo igikorwa cyangwa ngo usibe amakuru ya porogaramu; ubaze umuyobozi.

entries.en: The next outcome check is not due yet. The original action remains unresolved.
entries.rw: Tegereza mbere yo kongera kugenzura igisubizo. Ntusubiremo igikorwa cya mbere.
